Sodium chloride (NaCl) dissociates completely into Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions when dissolved in water.
Carbon-12 is the most abundant stable isotope of carbon.

There are infinitely many prime numbers, as proved by Euclid.
The mitochondrion is the primary site of ATP synthesis via oxidative phosphorylation in eukaryotic cells.
